dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Faint, irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped patterns are visible along the lateral torso, characterized by a soft gradient transition from dark, low-intensity perimeters to slightly lighter-toned interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of high-intensity specular highlights located on the ventral neck and lower jaw region. Low-intensity, solid-colored spots are distributed sporadically across the mid-dorsal pelt.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent lateral 'C' shaped patterns form an obtuse triangular relationship oriented horizontally along the seal's flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two anthropogenic tracking devices are visible on the dorsal surface: a large cylindrical transmitter with internal metallic components on the mid-dorsal ridge and a smaller, flatter rectangular device positioned more posteriorly.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical, high-contrast mystacial vibrissae (whiskers) are visible extending from the snout. Distinct circular specular reflections are present in both eyes.
